purpose: Preserve behavior, provenance, and architecture lessons from legacy N0TE before repository deletion without copying license-gated legacy source or test text.

salvage: reconstruct truth before editing
select work from artist/customer outcomes rather than subsystem adjacency
one bounded baseline-bound receipt before code
inspect/reuse before invention
do not create parallel Song/context/asset/version/attention/authority/business/provider models
normal consumer journey must reach result, verification, recovery/resume, and next action
red-team closure against inaccessible backends, duplicate models, stale prose, inflated mocks, and infinite context systems
systemic repair includes root cause, sibling scan, consequence scan, recurrence scan, regression proof, and normal-user verification
after each increment reconcile and globally reselect rather than continue by adjacency
repository entropy rule forbids duplicate roadmap/master-prompt/current-state authority documents
Artist and Song remain above DAWs/tools/providers
all advertised supported DAWs are peer deep-integration targets
implementation order, code volume, test count, or verification maturity has no semantic authority
job ownership modes are OWN, COORDINATE, INTEGRATE, ROUTE/REMEMBER
major journeys include IDEA->SONG, IMPROVE, FINISH, RELEASE, CREATOR, RELATIONSHIPS, AUDIENCE, BUSINESS/EARN, LEARN WHILE DOING, WHAT NEXT/DO NOTHING
compatibility launchers/adapters must not become current product architecture
large convergence branches are history/source, not preferred long-term merge units
automation evidence must state what it proves and what it cannot manufacture
real listening, DAW/provider/device behavior, usability, signing/notarization, and full-product convergence require separate evidence
historical green evidence is bounded to the exact implementation it proved
a model, endpoint, test, or package is not sufficient proof of a whole user job
capability acceptance is multidimensional rather than a single implemented flag
implementation maturity, runtime health, compatibility, real-system evidence, listening acceptance, and production acceptance are separate
one failed capability must not globally suppress healthy siblings
consumer-facing readiness must truthfully expose missing proof/dependencies

behavioral_quarry.preserved_failure: legacy LAN policy allowed a .local HTTPS address that selected policy expected to deny

confirmed_good_boundaries: current governance explicitly rejects direct legacy admission and source/test copying
current construction contract treats historical repos and old prompts as evidence only
current contract globally reselects work and forbids implementation maturity from mutating scope

duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.risk: The construction/controller mechanism can accrete product reasoning, durable semantics, or user-facing intelligence and become a second N0TE.
duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.required_boundary: Controller may reconstruct, select, authorize bounded construction, verify, reconcile, and orchestrate engineering work; durable Artist/Song intelligence, product memory, user-facing reasoning, and runtime autonomy belong to N0TE itself.

duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.risk: completion_graph/current_state/receipts can become a shadow product database.
duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.required_boundary: Governance stores construction state and evidence only; Song, Artist, Context, capability runtime, decisions, memories, relationships, and business state remain product models.

duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.risk: n0te2/consumer_shell.py is already a large integration surface and may become a monolithic route/service container.
duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.required_boundary: Shell owns composition and consumer routing, while domain rules/state stay in canonical modules. New domains should not be implemented as shell-local parallel models.

duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.risk: Adjacent user-state concepts can drift into parallel stores or duplicate recurrence/priority/history semantics.
duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.required_boundary: Define one canonical event/memory substrate and explicit projections for activity, attention, focus, timeline, and friction rather than independent truth stores.

duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.risk: capabilities.py and capability_evidence.py may encode overlapping authority or status truth.
duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.required_boundary: Capability descriptor/availability is canonical operational truth; evidence records proof/provenance and may not independently redefine capability semantics or authority.

duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.risk: Boundary is not presently evidenced in the inspected N0TE2 main tree and must not silently become another autonomous brain.
duplication_or_overbuild_watchlist.required_boundary: N0TED requires a narrow explicit contract before further growth; no duplicate memory, planner, authority, semantic graph, or Artist/Song model.
